0022600006.text: Cleveland opens its 2026-27 season on the road against Philadelphia, which has not yet played a game this season. The Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 victory in Cleveland on March 9, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Cleveland a 40% chance to win. Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are day-to-day for the Cavaliers and are game-time decisions, while the 76ers will be without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip).
